instruction: Help me plan a weekend trip to Tokyo.
output: Sure, I can help you plan a weekend trip to Tokyo. If this is your first time exploring Tokyo, I would suggest starting with classic experiences. On the first day, you could visit Asakusa Temple in the morning to experience traditional Tokyo, enjoy local food nearby for lunch, and then explore Ueno or Akihabara in the afternoon. In the evening, you could visit Shinjuku for city views and nightlife. On the second day, you could explore Shibuya Crossing, Meiji Shrine, and Omotesando. If you tell me your interests, such as food, shopping, photography, anime, or history, as well as your budget, I can further personalize the itinerary for you.
